source: 14,532 player-weeks 2023-25, Sleeper/Rotowire projection joined to actual, proj>=3
note: Band is applied around the Sleeper projection, not the median outcome. A single league-wide band is used on purpose: tier-specific bands would force 'neither' to ~50% for everyone by construction and destroy the signal. With a fixed 45% band, 'neither' being dominant for a given player is itself the safety measure.
